tool.name: nf-core tailfindr
tool.description: Estimating poly(A)-tail lengths from basecalled fast5 files produced by Nanopore sequencing of RNA and DNA
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ R --vanilla --slave -e "library(tailfindr); find_tails(fast5_dir = './' , save_dir = './' ${args}, csv_filename = \'${meta.id}.csv\', num_cores = ${task.cpus})"; gzip ${meta.id}.csv
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": tailfindr: \$(Rscript -e "cat(paste(packageVersion('tailfindr'), collapse='.'))") ont-fast5-api: \$(pip show ont-fast5-api | grep Version | awk '{print \$2}') END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
